description: Source code for handling 'Add' requests in a USP (Universal Service Platform) agent, including functions for processing add requests with partial and non-partial modes, resolving object paths, and generating responses.

methods.name: MSG_HANDLER_HandleAdd
methods.description: Main handler for processing incoming Add messages, validates message, and delegates to partial or non-partial processing functions.

methods.name: ProcessAdd_AllowPartialTrue
methods.description: Processes add requests with allow_partial=true, attempting to add all objects and collecting errors without aborting.

methods.name: ProcessAdd_AllowPartialFalse
methods.description: Processes add requests with allow_partial=false, aborting on first error and rolling back changes.

methods.name: ResolveObjectsToAdd
methods.description: Resolves a path expression into objects to add, adding results and errors to a vector.

methods.name: CreateFullAddResp
methods.description: Creates a comprehensive add response message based on the results in the group add vector.

methods.name: CreateBasicAddResp
methods.description: Creates an initial empty add response message.

methods.name: AddResp_OperSuccess
methods.description: Adds a success entry to the add response.

methods.name: AddResp_OperSuccess_ParamErr
methods.description: Adds a parameter error to a success entry.

methods.name: AddOperSuccess_UniqueKeys
methods.description: Transfers unique key mappings into a success response.

methods.name: AddResp_OperFailure
methods.description: Adds a failure entry to the add response.

methods.name: CreateAddResponseError
methods.description: Creates an error response message for a failed object creation.

methods.name: AreAllPathsTheSameGroupId
methods.description: Checks if all object paths in an add request target the same data model provider.

methods.name: CalcGroupIdForPath
methods.description: Calculates the group ID for a given path expression, considering wildcards and reference following.
